text:
maya: quick status + API q — pushing a small schema tweak for rerank before the canary. plan: add optional top_level"rank_metric" (enum: ["score", "logprob"]) and make "score" nullable; need to agree tie-break behavior and backcompat. cc @tom @leo

tom: quick read — sounds fine. current runtime does: sort by score desc, if score missing/NaN treat as -INF (so last), ties preserved by input order (stable sort). is that still what we want?

leo: fwiw legacy clients expect stable input order for equal scores. if we change tie rule we risk flakiness for users doing diffs. can we keep stable_input as default, and add an opt-in param for deterministic hashing?

maya: yes my proposal: default = stable_input to preserve backcompat. add new param "tie_strategy": optional enum ["stable_input", "hash_id"] where "hash_id" uses a deterministic hash on candidate_id + request_id to break ties. new clients can opt-in.

sara: sounds reasonable. question: when "score" is null vs missing, do we want different behavior? currently Tom says both treated as -INF. I think explicit null should be treated as -INF but log a metric to catch accidental nulls.

tom: agree — treat null and NaN as -INF and emit metric "rerank.score_missing" with tag source=client if score field present but null. if field absent, don't emit.

maya: example request shape I'm proposing (for docs):

```json
{
  "request_id": "req-123",
  "candidates": [
    {"candidate_id": "c1", "payload": {...}, "score": 0.92},
    {"candidate_id": "c2", "payload": {...}, "score": null} 
  ],
  "rank_metric": "score",  // optional, default: score
  "tie_strategy": "stable_input"  // optional
}
```

leo: minor nit — can we require candidate_id? yes we do. also add optional "client_order" index if callers want to enforce a specific stable ordering independent of input array (helps when arrays are from sets).

maya: good call. will add "client_order" (int). also propose that when tie_strategy=hash_id we compute hash = siphash(candidate_id || request_id) % 2^31 for deterministic break. add this to spec.

sara: for rollout: canary on dedicated first (low volume) with header X-Feature-Rerank-Tie-Hash: opt-in. deploy-bot will tag the canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for rerank tie-strategy feature on dedicated fleet at 1715055720. route 2% traffic for header opt-in.

tom: tests needed: unit tests for null/NaN handling, deterministic hash collision edge-case, e2e with legacy clients. I'll add a PR and ping reviewers.

leo: I'll update docs + changelog snippet: note default stable_input and metric emission for null scores.

maya: next steps: maya -> add schema PR, tom -> tests, leo -> docs, sara -> schedule canary observation window 24h. ping here when PRs up. thanks! :thumbsup:
